12.0.en: Between two stations Father's talk returned to the big [[liner:liner]], and he moored it among the mountains and rivers behind us.
12.0.zh: 两站之间，父亲又说回那艘大邮轮，把它泊进我们身后那片山水之间。

12.1.en: A slow [[vessel:vessel]] came down the river, and we both waved at its red flags.
12.1.zh: 一艘慢船顺河而下，我们俩都朝它挂着的红旗挥手。

12.2.en: Past the market square a [[ferry:ferry]] crossed the grey water twice an hour.
12.2.zh: 过了市场广场，有艘渡船每小时开两趟，渡过灰蒙蒙的水面。

12.3.en: Father said our worries would [[sail:sail]] away with the [[night:night]] train.
12.3.zh: 父亲说，我们的烦恼会随夜车飘然远去。

12.4.en: By the wide river we watched a [[raft:raft]] take a boy and five sheep across.
12.4.zh: 在宽宽的河边，我们看着一只木筏把一个小男孩和五只羊渡了过去。

12.5.en: Father drew a river on the table and talked about the [[canoe:canoe]] he rode years ago.
12.5.zh: 父亲在桌上画了一条河，说起他多年前划过的那只独木舟。

13.0.en: Father showed me the long [[wooden:wooden]] [[oar:oar]] leaning against the back wall.
13.0.zh: 父亲给我看了那根斜靠在后墙上的长木桨。

13.1.en: The best place on a ship, he said, was the windy [[deck:deck]] at the back.
13.1.zh: 他说，船上最好的地方就是后面那块迎着风的甲板。

13.2.en: The huge [[turbine:turbine]] behind the [[fence:fence]] made the whole market shake.
13.2.zh: 围栏后面那台巨大的涡轮机，震得整个集市都在晃。

13.3.en: A [[propeller:propeller]] on the screen turned so slowly that I watched it for minutes.
13.3.zh: 画面里的螺旋桨转得极慢，我盯着看了好几分钟。

13.4.en: None of us had seen the [[stern:stern]] of a ship, so we asked him to [[draw:draw]] it.
13.4.zh: 我们谁也没见过船尾是什么样子，就请他画出来。

13.5.en: Father called everyone [[aboard:aboard]] out of the cold [[mist:mist]], hot tea in his hands.
13.5.zh: 父亲端着热茶，把众人从冷雾里喊上了船。

14.0.en: At [[midnight:midnight]] I heard Father [[whisper:whisper]] in his sleep that we would [[embark:embark]] again at dawn, and I tucked the blanket around him.
14.0.zh: 午夜时分，我听见父亲在睡梦里低声念着天一亮又要启程，便轻轻替他掖好毯子。

14.1.en: Between the hills the ride grew [[quiet:quiet]], and Father traced the shape of the [[channel:channel]] on the seat for me.
14.1.zh: 山间的车程安静下来，父亲在座位上给我比划出那道海峡的形状。

14.2.en: With home finally in sight, Father laughed about the old [[canal:canal]], keeping the best part of the [[story:story]] for the garden gate.
14.2.zh: 终于望见家门，父亲笑着说起那条老运河，最好的一段留到院门口才讲。

14.3.en: Crossing the border on the way back, Father told me about the deep [[ditch:ditch]] beside the road and the rivers beyond.
14.3.zh: 回程过境时，父亲给我讲起路边那条深沟，还有更远处的条条江河。

14.4.en: [[flat:Flat]] land ran past the window, and Father said this whole [[railroad:railroad]] was built by hand.
14.4.zh: 平坦的土地从窗外掠过，父亲说这条铁路全凭人力一寸寸修成。

14.5.en: The new [[railway:railway]] cuts the mountains in two and brings people down to the market.
14.5.zh: 这条新铁路把山一分为二，也把人们带到了集市上。

15.0.en: A small [[locomotive:locomotive]] pulled six cars over the river, and the men beside us cheered.
15.0.zh: 一台小机车拖着六节车厢过了河，我们身旁几个男人欢呼起来。

15.1.en: We found an [[underground:underground]] and went down the steps together.
15.1.zh: 我们找到一个地铁站，一起走下了台阶。

15.2.en: We fell asleep before the train went under the hill, so we missed the long [[tunnel:tunnel]].
15.2.zh: 火车还没钻进山体我们就睡着了，所以错过了那条长长的隧道。

15.3.en: Right [[outside:Outside]] my window the [[steel:steel]] [[rail:rail]] ran straight to the edge of the fields.
15.3.zh: 就在车窗外面，钢轨笔直地一直伸到田野边上。

15.4.en: Out on the [[plain:plain]], warm sun on our hands, Father laughed about the morning we [[depart:departed]].
15.4.zh: 车到平原，日头暖着手，父亲笑说起我们出发那天早上的样子。

15.5.en: When the old farmer [[arrive:arrived]] late with his goats, the whole border market laughed at noon.
15.5.zh: 老农赶着羊来迟了，晌午的边境集市为这事笑了一场。

16.0.en: Father said our last [[destination:destination]] was one [[night:night]] away, and I could hardly sleep.
16.0.zh: 父亲说，离最后一个目的地只剩一个晚上的路程了，我兴奋得几乎睡不着。

16.1.en: Father and I waited out the long [[delay:delay]] in the [[quiet:quiet]] bakery while the old farmers sang.
16.1.zh: 父亲陪我在安静的面包店里熬过那段长长的晚点，老农们在旁边轻声唱歌。

16.2.en: No rain and no thick [[mist:mist]], Father said, would make us [[postpone:postpone]] the [[trip:trip]] we had waited years to take.
16.2.zh: 父亲说，雨也好雾也好，都拦不住这趟我们等了好几年才出门的旅行。

16.3.en: In the small hours I heard Father mumble about [[defer:deferring]] the [[trip:trip]], so I pulled the blanket over him.
16.3.zh: 夜深了，我听见父亲嘟囔着要把旅行往后推，就把毯子往他身上拉了拉。

16.4.en: There came a [[quiet:quiet]] [[lull:lull]] on our morning ride, and Father filled it with everything we had seen.
16.4.zh: 回程的清晨有一段安静的空当，父亲把我们一路上的见闻都填了进去。

16.5.en: So close to home, with lights in every window, Father laughed at our tickets that would [[expire:expire]] by morning.
16.5.zh: 离家这样近，家家窗里都有灯，父亲忽然笑起我们的车票来：到天亮就过期了。

17.0.en: While we rode home, Father worked out the money [[due:due]] for our tickets, then turned back to the rivers beyond.
17.0.zh: 回家的路上，父亲算清了我们要付的票钱，然后又转头去看远处的江河。

17.1.en: The extra [[postage:postage]] Father spoke of, over hot noodles, made our whole row [[burst:burst]] out laughing before the bowl was empty.
17.1.zh: 父亲说起那笔多出来的邮资，一碗面还没吃空，我们这一排人就笑翻了。

17.2.en: Father opened his notebook and drew a small [[stamp:stamp]] beside our [[trip:trip]] plan, to tell Mother at home.
17.2.zh: 父亲翻开小本子，在行程旁边画了一枚小邮票，说回家要讲给母亲听。

17.3.en: With our morning tea out in the yard, Father opened an old [[envelope:envelope]] from home.
17.3.zh: 早晨在院里喝茶时，父亲拆开了家里寄来的一只旧信封。

17.4.en: Our letters went into the [[mail:mail]] box, and Father said Mother would have them by Friday.
17.4.zh: 我们的信投进了邮筒，父亲说母亲星期五之前就能收到。

17.5.en: On the seat I found a [[packet:packet]] of thin cookies, still warm from the shop below.
17.5.zh: 我在座位上发现一小包薄饼干，从楼下店里带上来时还是温的。

18.0.en: A kind woman near us gave Father a small [[package:package]] of dried [[fruit:fruit]].
18.0.zh: 我们身边一位好心的女士给了父亲一小包果干。

18.1.en: Hot sun crossed the whole [[plain:plain]] while Father showed me how to [[bind:bind]] our bags together.
18.1.zh: 烈日从平原这头照到那头，父亲趁亮教我把两只行李捆成一束。

18.2.en: The border market was full at noon, and Father lifted a brown [[parcel:parcel]] off our seat.
18.2.zh: 正午集市挤满了人，父亲从座位上抱起一只棕色包袱。

18.3.en: Under its heavy [[load:load]], the little [[truck:truck]] moved slowly far behind our train.
18.3.zh: 那辆小卡车载着沉重的货物，慢慢地落在我们火车后面很远的地方。

18.4.en: Father never spoke about the real [[burden:burden]] of paying for all of our tickets.
18.4.zh: 父亲从没提起过为我们所有人买车票这份真正的重担。

18.5.en: Just past the border sign, with [[mist:mist]] on the windows, Father explained our [[transfer:transfer]] in a low voice.
18.5.zh: 刚过界碑，车窗上蒙着雾气，父亲压低声音给我们讲换乘的安排。

19.0.en: Late that night Father murmured in his sleep about the news we [[transmit:transmit]] home, and I tucked the blanket around him.
19.0.zh: 那天深夜，父亲在梦里咕哝着要给家里报消息，我把毯子给他掖好。

19.1.en: Father talked us through city [[transit:transit]] all the way back, and the morning ride stayed [[quiet:quiet]] around us.
19.1.zh: 回程一整路，父亲把城里的交通线路讲给我们听，四周一直安安静静。

19.2.en: Near home, Father laughed and said we always [[deliver:deliver]] our promises.
19.2.zh: 快到家时，父亲笑着说，我们许下的承诺总会兑现。

19.3.en: At [[dawn:dawn]] the conductor asked the tall boys to [[convey:convey]] the news down the train and clear the doorway for the old folks.
19.3.zh: 拂晓，列车员请高个男孩们把消息传下去，并给老人们让出门口。

19.4.en: At full [[speed:speed]] the little cups on our table danced, and we all laughed.
19.4.zh: 车开到全速的时候，我们桌上的小杯子直跳，大家都笑了。

19.5.en: Nothing on this [[plain:plain]] [[can:can]] reach the [[velocity:velocity]] of that morning train.
19.5.zh: 平原上没有任何东西赶得上那趟早晨火车的速度。

20.0.en: Some [[swift:swift]] birds went over the wall while Father and I stood in the morning yard with our tea.
20.0.zh: 我和父亲捧着茶站在清晨的院里，几只轻快的鸟掠过墙头飞走了。

20.1.en: Father read a little about [[marxism:marxism]] on the ride home and asked what I had heard.
20.1.zh: 回家的路上父亲读了一点马克思主义的东西，还问我听说过些什么。

20.2.en: Two men played cards and argued about [[socialism:socialism]] until the [[fire:fire]] in the room went out.
20.2.zh: 两个男人一边打牌一边争论社会主义，直到屋里的火都熄了。

20.3.en: Two old men at the next table argued about [[communism:communism]] while we ate our bread.
20.3.zh: 我们吃面包的时候，邻桌的两位老人正争论着共产主义。

20.4.en: Father laughed out loud about how [[strict:strict]] our morning [[regime:regime]] was, with the bright [[plain:plain]] running past the window.
20.4.zh: 父亲大声笑谈我们清晨那套作息有多严格，窗外明亮的平原正飞驰而过。

20.5.en: An officer in [[authority:authority]] came up at noon, and Father answered him politely in the middle of the market.
20.5.zh: 中午有位当权的官员走过来，父亲站在集市当中客客气气地回他的话。

21.0.en: Mother asked why [[political:political]] news filled every [[paper:paper]] that week.
21.0.zh: 母亲问，为什么那一周每份报纸都登满了政治新闻。

21.1.en: Father drew a row of boxes on the window, so the old [[hierarchy:hierarchy]] of titles became clear.
21.1.zh: 父亲在车窗上画了一排方框，那些老头衔的等级次序一下子就清楚了。

21.2.en: At [[midnight:midnight]] a soft [[bell:bell]] rang, and Father woke me to tell a quiet little [[story:story]] about [[democracy:democracy]] under the silver moon.
21.2.zh: 午夜一声柔和的铃响，父亲叫醒我，在银色月光下讲了一个关于民主的小故事。

21.3.en: As for what [[bureaucracy:bureaucracy]] meant, Father waited for the [[host:host]] to finish the news before explaining it to me.
21.3.zh: 至于官僚主义是什么，父亲等主持人念完那条新闻才给我解释。

21.4.en: Climbing the steps with our baskets and warm coats, we boarded the bright [[night:night]] train where every seat felt [[egalitarian:egalitarian]].
21.4.zh: 我们提着篮子、裹着暖外套登上台阶，上了那趟明亮的夜车，车上每个座位都让人觉着人人平等。

21.5.en: Father saved his [[story:story]] about empty [[materialism:materialism]] for the dark road between the last two lights.
21.5.zh: 在最后两盏灯之间那段黑路上，父亲才讲起那个劝人别只顾贪恋物质的故事。

22.0.en: Mountains, rivers, and one old [[revolution:revolution]]: Father made them one for the whole of our ride.
22.0.zh: 山、水，还有一场旧日的革命——这一路车坐下来，父亲把它们说成了同一件事。

22.1.en: Hot tea in one hand, bread in the other, Father told me again about the old [[reform:reform]].
22.1.zh: 一手热茶，一手面包，父亲又跟我讲起那场旧改革。

22.2.en: Father took the [[conservative:conservative]] choice: the longer road, but the safer one.
22.2.zh: 父亲选了保守的那条路：远一些，可是更安全。

22.3.en: Father told me the sad [[story:story]] of the [[quiet:quiet]] [[meltdown:meltdown]] that closed the old bakery behind the market.
22.3.zh: 父亲给我讲了那场无声无息的垮台如何关掉了市场后面那家老面包店，语气很伤感。

22.4.en: Father praised the [[municipal:municipal]] inn where our [[host:host]] gave us hot tea and warm blankets late at [[night:night]].
22.4.zh: 父亲称赞那间市营的小旅店，店主深更半夜还给我们端来热茶和暖毯。

22.5.en: When the two men started to shout, I stayed [[neutral:neutral]] and kept drinking my tea.
22.5.zh: 那两个人吵嚷起来的时候，我保持中立，自顾自地喝着茶。

23.0.en: A [[bilateral:bilateral]] [[deal:deal]], Father said, is just two countries agreeing to build one bridge.
23.0.zh: 父亲说，所谓双边协议，就是两个国家谈好了一起修一座桥。

23.1.en: Dusty and empty in the sun, the old [[arena:arena]] became another [[story:story]] of our [[plain:plain]] crossing.
23.1.zh: 那座旧竞技场落满灰、空空荡荡，被太阳一照，又成了我们这趟横过平原的故事之一。

23.2.en: Above the noon market a red [[banner:banner]] moved, and Father pointed until everyone looked.
23.2.zh: 晌午的集市上方飘动着一面红横幅，父亲一直指着，直到所有人都抬起头。

23.3.en: In the second country we had just reached, our talk under the lamps turned to a [[company:company]] and its [[president:president]].
23.3.zh: 在刚抵达的第二国，灯下我们聊起了一家公司和它的总裁。

23.4.en: With our baskets and coats we climbed aboard, and the conductor gave us the [[premier:premier]] seats on the bright [[night:night]] train.
23.4.zh: 我们提着篮子、穿着外套上了车，列车员把那趟明亮夜车上最好的座位给了我们。

23.5.en: Grey hills sitting quietly by the track in the morning [[mist:mist]], Father said, looked like a kind old [[minister:minister]] at rest.
23.5.zh: 清晨的雾里，灰灰的山安静地蹲在铁道旁，父亲说那模样像一位和气的老部长在歇息。

paraZh.12: 两站之间忆邮轮，看渡船木筏与独木舟，烦恼随夜车远去。
paraZh.13: 看长木桨说甲板船尾，画船图，冷雾里端热茶喊众人上船。
paraZh.14: 午夜父亲梦话启程，山间画海峡，望见家门把好故事留到院门口。
paraZh.15: 小机车过河众人欢呼，同游地铁错过隧道，钢轨直伸田野边。
paraZh.16: 距终点只剩一夜，晚点时听老农唱歌，谁也拦不下这趟旅行。
paraZh.17: 算票钱讲邮资笑翻一排人，画邮票拆旧信封，座上发现暖饼干。
paraZh.18: 好心的女士赠果干，父亲捆行李抱包袱，低声讲换乘与车费重担。
paraZh.19: 深夜梦话报消息，讲城里交通，拂晓传话让门，全速时小杯直跳。
paraZh.20: 院中捧茶看雨燕，一路听人争论主义，笑谈规矩严，集市遇官员。
paraZh.21: 母亲问报纸为何尽是政治新闻，父亲画方框讲等级，午夜铃里讲民主。
paraZh.22: 山川旧革命融为一谈，讲旧改革叹老店垮台，吵嚷中我自喝茶。
paraZh.23: 谈双边协议如合修一桥，看竞技场红横幅，夜车上坐进最好的座位。
